sources.kidera_and_hydropathy: peptides.py 0.5.0; Kidera et al. 1985 and Kyte-Doolittle 1982 tables exposed by the package
sources.nominal_sidechain_charge: peptides.py Henderson-Hasselbalch charge; computed as charge(GGXGG)-charge(GGGGG) at pH 7.4 to cancel terminal contributions
sources.standard_structure: RDKit Chem.MolFromFASTA(residue, flavor=0), which constructs standard L-amino-acid peptide chemistry from IUPAC one-letter codes
sources.sidechain_definition: RDKit PDB residue atom names; backbone atoms N/CA/C/O/OXT are excluded automatically
sources.structural_features: RDKit aromaticity/ring perception and Lipinski donor/acceptor SMARTS; small functional-group flags are substructure matches restricted to side-chain atoms

redundancy.note: Redundancy flags are descriptive only. They do not automatically delete features or set MCDA weights.

method_freeze: D-Lys is fixed upstream; this table describes only the second-block candidate X.
The 17 candidates remain in the three pre-frozen mechanism domains; no clustering is performed.
No final candidate ranking, TOPSIS score, Pareto score, or learned weight is produced in this module.
Kidera factors represent a continuous physicochemical space; their signs are not interpreted as universally good or bad.
Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy is retained as one human-readable hydrophobicity axis, not duplicated with multiple hydropathy scales in V1.
Nominal side-chain charge is an idealized pH 7.4 descriptor, not the measured charge of poly(X) in a material environment.
HBD/HBA values are reference-structure side-chain counts and are not a pH-specific protonation-state simulation.
RDKit whole-free-amino-acid MolLogP/TPSA/molecular-weight descriptor panels are deliberately excluded from the core matrix.
Known F/L/Q experimental outcomes are not used to select fields, tune thresholds, or assign weights.
Side-chain branch distance is nullable by design when no SP3 side-chain branch point exists; NA is not imputed to zero.
